name: Líšnice (Prague-West District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a white hoist part and green fly part, with a diagonal band of blue and yellow along the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 18 May 2012 (decision No. 33) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
